_doc: Reference-plate manifest for Pin Oak (Quercus palustris). Stage-0 source list; binaries download in Stage-1 ingest (downloaded:false). Jacob ratifies identification (ratified:false).
identityNotes: Diagnostic three-tier branching (upper ascending, middle horizontal, lower descending/pendulous) — unmistakable winter silhouette. Red-oak group, bristle-tipped lobes; dead lower 'pin' stubs persist.

plates.caption: Pyramidal crown with descending lower limbs; deeply cut bristle-lobed leaves.
Smooth grey-brown trunk with shallow young ridging.
